consumer_rule: Consume certification_id and overall_digest_sha256 exactly; do not reconstruct Workbench selection.
authority_boundary: The certificate supplies only Workbench/pre-Draft expected facts. It contains no Draft-produced allocation row, Draft item identity, Draft reservation row, post-Draft materialisation fact or parity verdict; HANDOVER_2 derives and compares those through the existing Draft authorities.

canonicalization.amounts: canonical fixed decimal strings, never JSON binary floating-point numbers

publications.publication_attestation_digest_sha256: 64 lowercase hex over the existing attestation object

component_evidence.full_signed_pre_signature_match_ordered_: array whose length equals the count

validation_semantics: Reject unless overall_digest_sha256 equals SHA-256(stableStringify(sealed_payload)) and certification_id equals WORKBENCH_SETTLED_CERTIFICATION_V1:<digest>.
Reject unless every session, progress, source snapshot, scope generation and per-Candidate publication identity is current and mutually equal at one read-only certification boundary.
Reject unless all selected rows are fetched server-side in the declared order to a bounded sentinel, every count agrees, and no browser page or loaded UI subset is used as authority.

Reject unless the complete ordered Ready, Action Required and Blocked universe digests are present, their identities are pairwise disjoint, and the complete ordered active-Draft, ineligible and snoozed exclusion universes are proved from existing owners.
Reject unless selected constituents are exactly the complete selected READY/draftable universe and their ordinals are contiguous and unique.
Reject unless partitions are a lossless one-to-one cover of constituent ordinals with no duplicate or omitted constituent and exact decimal totals.

Reject unless payment_policy_parity is present, its before and after digests are identical, forbidden_policy_delta_count is zero, execution_recovery_delta_only and no_payment_policy_change are true, and the rollback-contained runtime fixture passed at the exact sealed release identity.

Apply signed-evidence cardinality only after the full signed pre-signature filter. Ordinary same-key components do not count; two genuine matches, incomplete evidence or tampering prevents certificate issuance.
Reject unless installed database, Worker, frontend, generated contract and Bible identities all match the exact accepted sealed release.

Reject unless every source identity and Workbench/pre-Draft allocation, item and source-reservation expectation is supplied by its existing owner, is internally digest-bound and agrees with the constituent amount, publication and economic key.

Reject any purported certificate that contains a Draft-produced allocation-row identity, Draft item identity, Draft reservation-row identity, post-Draft materialisation fact or parity verdict; those remain HANDOVER_2 outputs owned by existing Draft authorities.

This certificate is constituent comparison and policy-parity evidence only. It does not replace or alter Draft economics, allocation, item, reservation, materialisation, replay, abort or Policy X owners.
